newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bakrie, Br.Steel said in venture.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie, Br.Steel said in venture.

text.p: Indonesian holding company PT Bakrie & Brothers will build a 2000-hectare industrial estate in Lampung, South Sumatra with estimated investment of 10 trillion rupiah, Kompas newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The daily quoted an executive of the Lampung coordinating investment bureau, Nuril Hakim, as saying development would start by the end of 1997 and be completed by 2014.
Hakim said 1,000 hectares of the industrial complex would be used for a steel plant, in which Bakrie and British Steel will jointly invest 2.94 trillion rupiah (US$1.2 billion).
A Bakrie official declined to comment on the report.
The newspaper reported that according to Bakrie's master plan, inter-island trade and export activity from the area will be supported by three ports and one airport.

Kompas newspaper also reported that Bakrie & Brothers's chairman Aburizal Bakrie had submitted a proposal to the governor of Lampung for the provision of electricity to the estate from a state-owned power firm in the area.
